Student Assistant
Imagine a future where you help strengthen cyber security and compliance across a global renewable energy company while developing valuable skills in risk management, data analysis, and process improvement.

Ørsted Services A/S

Some of our benefits include:

Proven very high employee satisfaction and motivation

Continuous development opportunities for all employees

Competitive salary, pension scheme, and attractive holiday package

A wide range of health benefits, such as health insurance, nutritious food, and fitness facilities in our office locations

Join us in this role where you’ll support the Risk & Compliance team by helping manage key governance and compliance processes, analysing data, maintaining documentation, and assisting with reporting. You’ll gain hands-on experience in cyber security and risk management while working closely with specialists across a global organisation.
 
Welcome to Risk & Compliance
You’ll be part of Risk & Compliance within Cyber Security, where you together with your colleagues will help protect Ørsted’s critical systems and information through governance, risk management, and compliance activities. Working alongside experienced specialists and fellow student assistants, you’ll contribute to operational processes, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives across the organisation. As a team, we value collaboration, knowledge sharing, and finding smarter ways of working. 
 
You’ll play an important role in:
running daily compliance processes, including supporting the dispensation process for security control deviations
addressing queries via email and ticketing systems, and coordinating with colleagues to ensure timely resolution
assisting with data collection, analysis, insights, and reporting for risk and compliance activities
maintaining and updating documentation, guidelines, procedures, and process materials
supporting continuous improvement initiatives, including opportunities for automation and process optimisation
contributing to governance activities by preparing materials, tracking actions, and supporting stakeholder communication.
 
To succeed in the role, you:
are pursuing a degree in business, risk management, cyber security, information technology, law, or a related field, or equivalent experience
have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and enjoy working with data
possess excellent communication and teamwork abilities, and can collaborate effectively with different stakeholders
have experience with Excel, Power BI, or similar tools, and are comfortable working with data and reporting
have a positive attitude, strong drive, and an eagerness to learn and develop new skills
thrive in a dynamic environment, take initiative, and have a structured approach to your work.
 
Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

Position salary range:
For this position, the expected base pay range is kr13,750.00- kr15,416.67 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

Our benefits package:
For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11% contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3% holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and wellbeing programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

Pre-employment background check:
Certain positions may require a background check as part of the hiring process. If applicable, you will be informed during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Join a global leader in renewable energy

Ørsted is a global leader in offshore wind and is one of the largest renewable energy companies in the world. With us, you’ll play your part in creating a world that runs entirely on green energy. As a leading green energy company, we leverage the curiosity and passion of our people to innovate and develop new technologies or bring existing technologies to scale, collaborating with governments, suppliers, and our industry partners to make renewable energy solutions a reality. At Ørsted, we work together with openness and respect and seek fresh perspectives to solve any task at hand: big or small. 

About Ørsted


We provide countries, companies, and communities with sustainable, reliable, and cost-competitive energy solutions, including offshore and onshore wind, solar PV, and energy storage.
Our vision is to create a world that runs entirely on green energy.
We built the world’s first offshore wind farm, Vindeby in Denmark, in 1991, and completed the world’s largest, Hornsea 2 in the UK, in 2022.
We were founded in Denmark in 2006 and now have approximately 8,000 employees, working in 15 countries and counting. 

An inclusive team

At Ørsted, we strive to be an inclusive workplace where you’re respected for who you are, valued for the unique perspectives you bring, and rewarded fairly for what you achieve. We want all employees to have the same opportunities for impact and growth, no matter their age, race, ethnicity, place of birth, gender, sexual orientation, or disability.

About Ørsted

Ørsted is a global leader in developing, constructing, and operating offshore wind farms, with a core focus on Europe. Backed by 35 years of experience in offshore wind, Ørsted has 11 GW of installed offshore capacity and 7.2 GW under construction. Ørsted’s total installed renewable energy capacity spanning Europe, Asia Pacific, and North America exceeds 19 GW across a portfolio that also includes onshore wind, solar power, energy storage, bioenergy plants, and energy trading. Ørsted has been recognised for its sustainability performance, including maintaining a CDP Climate A score and inclusion in the Corporate Knights Global 100 ranking, and is guided by its vision of a world that runs entirely on green energy. Headquartered in Denmark, Ørsted employs approximately 7,300 people. Ørsted's shares are listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen (Orsted). In 2025, the group's operating profit excluding new partnerships and cancellation fees was DKK 25.1 billion (EUR 3.4 billion).
